claims.text: The model utilizes dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to encode information from audio and text sequences simultaneously.
Information from audio and text sources is combined using a feed-forward neural model to predict the emotion class.
The architecture analyzes speech data from both the signal level and the language level for a comprehensive understanding.
